A new `SpeedColumn` is a feature request, so it needs approval in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue can be considered. Please open a discussion for it first.

Some existing options may cover part of this: `TaskProgressColumn(show_speed=True)` shows speed when `total` is unknown, and `TransferSpeedColumn` covers byte speeds (see [docs/source/progress.rst](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/progress.rst)). A custom unit would need a new `ProgressColumn` subclass.

Related earlier reports: #304, #1964, #3835.
